product.olivetti-echos-pro-150s.summary: The Echos Pro 150S appears under its own name in an inventory and battery documentation.
product.olivetti-echos-pro-150s.history: The Museo del Computer records an Echos Pro 150S. In 1999, Powerline listed it by name in its battery catalogue alongside the Pro P133.
product.olivetti-echos-pro-150s.architec: The battery reference helps identify accessories. Powerline lists a 9.6 V, 3,500 mAh NiMH battery for the 150S and Pro P133.
product.olivetti-echos-pro-150s.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-echos-pro-150s.limitati: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
